sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it generates high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design. Contents: Key Features | Installation | Quick Start | Python API | Command-Line Tools | Training ...

sources.snippet: Omni Voice Connects Every Step of Text to Speech The Omni Voice AI Voice Generator brings voice discovery, TTS rendering, consent-based cloning, voice design, saved generations, and downloads into one browser workflow centered on editable words.
